packaged_reproduction.before: Workspace settings retained the Claude refresh spinner after the collector process exited.
packaged_reproduction.after_navigation: Switching to Agent roles settled the job and displayed the refresh button and the completed observation.

root_cause: Native metadata snapshot polling was restricted to workspace_step == 1 although the agent sidebar is shared by all three steps.
fix: Remove the Team-only condition; reuse existing active-only async polling.

regression.red: step 0 must poll the shared sidebar metadata job
regression.green: All three steps observe completion, preserve unsaved name/goal/selection, and do not poll idle metadata.
